recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future editorial cleanup for this extension should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than by reintroducing a core extension definition.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asked whether observation-precondition should be a modifier extension. The final resolution rejected modifier treatment and instead changed the definition from observations needed to correctly interpret the observation to observations needed to understand its context and significance.
initial_application: No current core StructureDefinition source remains for observation-precondition; core only retains the OID entry. Core commit dd468d4f17 removed the former source/observation/structuredefinition-extension-observation-precondition.xml file from R5 source, and Extension Pack commits 5b5b79c and c0d3f2e applied the Jira-requested wording changes to input/definitions/Observation/StructureDefinition-observation-precondition.xml.
additional_context: Jira comments and meeting evidence explain that modifier elements/extensions are for cases where the meaning of the resource or modified element itself is significantly changed. Observation-precondition can affect clinical action, but it does not change the Observation value itself. The current Extension Pack StructureDefinition is based on Extension, not modifierExtension, and includes the approved context-and-significance wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source change was made because the active source of truth is the FHIR Extension Pack and it is already aligned with the Jira resolution.
